visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows. Example: `shadow-sm` for default cards, `shadow-md` for hover.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness `rounded-lg` (8px) for containers, `rounded-md` for inputs/buttons.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for sticky headers or modals: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/40`.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High density grid: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6`.
layouts.bento_summary: Top level stats using Bento approach. E.g., `col-span-1` for single metrics, `col-span-2 row-span-2` for Recharts graph.
layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards: `p-6` or `p-8`.
layouts.alignment: Left-align forms, lists, and dense content for high readability.

component_usage.forms: Shadcn `Form`, `Input`, `Select`. DO NOT use native HTML inputs.
component_usage.tables: Shadcn `Table` for customer lists, billing history, and active connections.
component_usage.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts) for Admin Dashboard (Pemasukan vs Pengeluaran).
component_usage.cards: Shadcn `Card` with customized spacing and minimal shadow.
component_usage.dialogs: Shadcn `Dialog` for generating vouchers or editing router settings.
component_usage.tabs: Shadcn `Tabs` for switching between PPPoE and Hotspot management.

motion.hover: Subtle translations and shadow increases. E.g., `hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md transition-[transform,box-shadow] duration-200`.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in up for list items and dashboard cards.
motion.loading: Shadcn `Skeleton` for all async data sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards against backgrounds. Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content.

images.category: Customer Portal / Router Settings illustration or Auth screen banner
Agent / Warung Portal Auth background or profile illustration

media.icons: Use `lucide-react` (already installed) for all dashboard icons (users, wifi, credit-card, activity, router, etc).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-density SaaS dashboard for an Indonesian ISP (RT/RW-Net).
Implement 3 main roles/views: Admin, Customer, and Agent (Warung).
Use 'Work Sans' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Install these via Google Fonts in index.html.
Ensure exact 1px borders and slight shadows on cards. Do not overuse massive shadows.
For the Admin Dashboard, implement a financial chart (pemasukan vs pengeluaran) using Recharts.
For the Customer Portal, focus on clear billing status, a prominent 'Pay via Payment Gateway' button, and a simple card to manage PPPoE router settings (SSID/Password).
For the Agent Portal, create a fast, POS-like interface to generate Hotspot Vouchers.
Never use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components exclusively for forms and interactions.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Language must be in Indonesian as requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container in css. Left-align dense data for readability.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
